model_1_without_dndbi_control.specification: dLST ~ Intercept + beta_green * Treated (Bivariate DiD with 2km spatial cluster SE)
model_1_without_dndbi_control.interpretation: Without conditioning on post-treatment mediator dNDBI, greening significantly reduces warming by -1.37 C (or -0.77 C per +0.10 dNDVI).

model_2_with_dndbi_control.specification: dLST ~ Intercept + beta_green * Treated + gamma * dNDBI (Adjusted DiD with 2km spatial cluster SE)
model_2_with_dndbi_control.interpretation: Controlling for dNDBI absorbs the cooling effect because vegetation growth mechanically lowers NDBI (bad control / mediator). NDBI is defined as (SWIR - NIR)/(SWIR + NIR); leaf expansion increases NIR and depresses NDBI. Both specifications are reported for econometric transparency.
